rules: All shapes are exact; decimal epochs are nonzero u64 strings, generation/digest references must resolve and all arrays have finite limits. Every represented operation binds at least one execution dependency.
Ownership/capture epochs in a request match the observed view. Unknown fields, duplicate resources or unresolved dependency references refuse as malformed input.
A resource has one owner; overlapping case-insensitive relative resource roots refuse. Fixture path spelling is not physical alias or ownership proof.

Only payload/provider/integration resources owned by the requesting recognized servicing owner enter review. Unmanaged/external ownership requires separate enrollment or transfer; no implicit takeover.

Every dependency uses the current capture epoch. Incomplete capture, a stale operation capture or an unreachable worker defers all requested retirement because its complete current scope is unknown. Active/unresolved/running/uncertain/held/unknown/recovery-required dependencies defer affected retirement.
Cancellation is observational and cannot override any dependency. Terminal worker exit does not imply successful effects or discharged recovery.
Repair selections and exclusions are copied from the accepted fixture view; requested selection/policy changes are outside this profile and refuse.
A withdrawal preview proposes deny_new_work only for exact provider generations while preserving required bytes; it does not apply capability policy, grant storage authority or delete files.
Eligible means this review-model constraint passed. authorizes_lifecycle remains false, requires_atomic_recheck remains true; there is no executor or installed-state truth.
